capital_gains.encoding: [maximum taxable income for 0%, maximum taxable income for 15%]; above second threshold generally20%, excluding special-category gains. Qualified dividends/long-term gains stack above ordinary taxable income.

child_credit.refundable_formula: unknown here; earned-income and other eligibility restrictions must be separately applied
child_credit.eligibility: Qualifying child age/relationship/residence/SSN and tax-ID requirements; not every entered dependent qualifies.
child_credit.note: 2026 maximum/refundable amount explicitly verified in Rev Proc2025-32; 2025 Schedule8812 establishes phaseout computation.

obbba_deductions.MAGI_definition: AGI plus excluded Puerto Rico income, Form2555 lines45/50 and Form4563 line15 (Schedule1-A). Deductions below reduce taxable income rather than simply subtracting qualifying income from wages/payroll tax.

tips.eligibility: Qualified reported voluntary tips in listed occupations; self-employment limited to net profit; SSTB restrictions.

overtime.eligibility: Only qualifying premium above regular pay, e.g. half portion of time-and-half; SSN/reporting requirements.

car_interest.eligibility: Personal-use qualifying new vehicle loan after2024, lien-secured, US final assembly, under14000lb; leases excluded; no duplicate business deduction.

senior.note: Each eligible spouse gets same phased amount, separate from age/blind extra standard deduction.

obbba_deductions.year2026_form_status: 2026 arithmetic uses currently verified 2025 statutory schedule and IRS effective2025–28 summary; final2026 form not opened.

amt.note: AMTI requires tax preference adjustments; cannot compute AMT by merely applying26/28% to ordinary taxable income. Special capital-gain rates still apply. Full Form6251 adjustment logic not enumerated here.
